name: Pradhin Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Pradhin Ltd is in the business of manufacturing milk and milk-related products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PL is engaged in the marketing activity of
retail and wholesale basis for:
a) Agro based products
b) Dairy products
c) Food Stuffs
d) Cereals
e) Grains
f) Groceries 
g) Cosmetics
h) Provisions
i) Tea & Coffee

pros: Stock is trading at 0.23 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 59.1% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 7.32% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.9.00 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 114 to 138 days.
